findings.title: `upsampled_count` does not fall back to 1 when `sample_weight` is null or unset
findings.body: `upsampled_count` is defined as `toInt64(sum(sample_weight))`, assuming every error event in an allowlisted project has a populated `sample_weight`. In practice, unsampled error events, events ingested before client error sampling was enabled for the project, or events from SDKs that do not send `contexts.error_sampling.client_sample_rate` have `sample_weight` as `NULL` or `0` (or `<= 1`). Summing `sample_weight` directly causes all such unsampled events to contribute `0` instead of `1` to the count (returning `0` when no events have `sample_weight` set). The aggregation should fall back to `1` when `sample_weight` is null or not greater than `1` (e.g., `if(greater(sample_weight, 1), sample_weight, 1)` or `greatest(ifNull(sample_weight, 1), 1)`).

findings.title: Caching allowlist eligibility causes stale results and breaks when allowlist option changes
findings.body: `is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects` caches `_are_all_projects_error_upsampled` in `sentry.utils.cache.cache` for 60 seconds keyed by `organization.id` and `hash(tuple(sorted(snuba_params.project_ids)))`. However, `invalidate_upsampling_cache` is never called anywhere when `issues.client_error_sampling.project_allowlist` is updated (and cannot practically invalidate arbitrary cached `(organization_id, project_ids)` combinations when a global option changes). This contradicts `_are_all_projects_error_upsampled`'s documented behavior of reading the allowlist fresh each time, causes stale eligibility results when the option changes (including across tests that mock or update `options` for the same organization and project IDs), and adds an unnecessary external cache lookup on every stats query when `sentry.options.get` already caches option values in memory with automatic invalidation.

findings.title: `_get_event_stats` passes outer `dataset` instead of `scoped_dataset` to upsampling check
findings.body: Inside `_get_event_stats`, `is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects(snuba_params, organization, dataset, request)` is called with the outer `dataset` variable rather than the `scoped_dataset` parameter passed to `_get_event_stats`. When `get_event_stats_factory` handles dashboard widget splitting under `metrics_enhanced`, the outer `dataset` is `metrics_performance` or `metrics_enhanced_performance`, while `_get_event_stats` is invoked with `scoped_dataset=discover` for error queries. Passing `dataset` instead of `scoped_dataset` causes `_should_apply_sample_weight_transform` to see the metrics dataset and always return `False` for those error queries.

findings.title: Substring check in `_is_error_focused_query` matches negated or compound queries
findings.body: `_is_error_focused_query` checks `if "event.type:error" in query:` using a raw substring match on the query string. A query that explicitly excludes errors such as `!event.type:error` (for example, when querying transactions) or a disjunction such as `event.type:error OR event.type:transaction` still contains the substring `"event.type:error"` and will erroneously trigger error upsampling on non-error events.

findings.title: Accidental git submodule `sentry-repo` committed
findings.body: The PR adds a `sentry-repo` git submodule/gitlink pointing to `a5d290951def84afdcc4c88d2f1f20023fc36e2a` at the repository root without a corresponding `.gitmodules` entry. This appears to be an accidentally committed nested repository and should be removed.
